approachAdjustment: Extend rather than rebuild: add created_at/last_activity to RunEntry with idle and absolute TTL enforced by a reaper shared with F-t2-006; widen AgentRunCheckpoint.status beyond Active/Closed (suspended, failed) and implement suspend as release with a persisted profile (already what close_run + persist_profile does for non-ZDR runs); wire resume_run_id into execution-core's StartRunRequest and add the rehydration test the roadmap gate asks for; add idempotent create keyed by a start key like model-gateway's managed_start_key. Implement view-only as a scope on the existing owner-checked routes and WS rather than bearer URLs, and treat cross-user sharing as a separate ADR. Recording only for non-ZDR with an org flag; ReplayContext after F-t2-023 on top of browser_procedure.rs.
